Rudolf Peltzer (1825-1910) began collecting in 1860 and was an avid Old Master painting, prints and drawings collector. His prints included the works of Rembrandt, Dürer and French portraitists. Peltzer strove to include all schools and all major engravers in his collection.

Walter J. Johnson (1908 - 1996) was a German émigré who founded Academic Press in New York and London. Academic Press has published most of the Nobel Laureates of science. He also carried on the family tradition of collecting, with a specific passion in the etchings of Rembrandt, as he considered Rembrandt the greatest of all artists.
